One RD frame, shape 1 x Doppler x 64 range. Native map 124 Doppler x 2048 range (Doppler raw bins [2:126] of 128).

Block max-pooling of the linear-magnitude map over contiguous near-equal bin groups (`np.array_split`, `kurals/dataset_process/resize_extracted_dataset.py`, same code for all three). Range 2048 -> 64: exactly 32 bins per cell. **Doppler 124 -> 8 / 16 / 32: groups of 15-16 / 7-8 / 3-4 bins** (not an integer ratio, so group sizes differ by one). The result is an emulation of the SoC grid (which uses its own small FFT from raw samples; no raw IQ here).

Dense masks are not resampled as images: every foreground cell of the native one-hot mask is remapped through the same bin lookup; background = complement; dilate_radius = 0 (no label dilation at any resolution).

`hflip,vflip` on the training split only (random horizontal and vertical flips, applied to the stored layout before the DSP code and ifftshift). No gain/noise jitter.
